method: CPU-burner tool (unbounded busy loop) run in the isolated subprocess path (ab.body.sandbox.IsolatedToolRunner, cpu_seconds=2, wall timeout 30s). Two burner runs plus a fast-tool control in the same runner. killed=False means the PARENT did not kill the child (the runner sets killed only when its own wall-time kill fires); exitcode -9 is the kernel's RLIMIT_CPU enforcement — soft and hard limits are equal (2s), so the kernel sends SIGXCPU and SIGKILL together and SIGKILL terminates the process. The sandbox reports only the exit code; it does not label the cause. Attribution rests on elimination: no parent kill, no wall-time timeout (timed_out=False, timeout 30s), and the tool was still burning CPU when it died.
cause_as_reported: exitcode -9 (SIGKILL); sandbox does not label the cause — attributed to the kernel's RLIMIT_CPU enforcement by elimination (no parent kill, no wall-time timeout; tool still burning CPU)
